# Waylo

> Waylo is an AI chat for B2B and SaaS websites. It learns a company's public web pages, answers visitor questions with links to its sources, detects buying intent, and hands warm leads to the team in Slack or a CRM. It installs with one script tag.

Site: https://waylo-j5hv.onrender.com · Contact: https://waylo-j5hv.onrender.com/contact · Status: early access

## Key facts
- Answers are grounded in crawled public HTML pages plus facts the customer adds; every answer cites sources.
- When content doesn't cover a question, Waylo says so and offers a handoff instead of guessing.
- Buying-intent signals: pricing, integration, security, and demo interest.
- Integrations: Slack incoming webhook and a JSON outbound webhook (route to HubSpot, Salesforce, etc. via Zapier, Make, or your own endpoint). No native CRM apps yet.
- Install: `<script src="https://waylo-j5hv.onrender.com/waylo.js" data-site="YOUR_SITE" async></script>` before </body>. Works with Webflow, WordPress, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Google Tag Manager.
- Embed modes: launcher (default), sidebar, track (analytics only).
- Pricing: Trial $0 (1 site, 500 AI messages); Starter $79/mo (3,000 messages, webhooks, handoff); Growth $249/mo (3 sites, 15,000 messages, Audiences).
- AI model: OpenAI API (gpt-4o-mini by default).
- Not available today: SSO/SAML, SOC 2 report, native CRM apps, live agent chat, white-label, JavaScript-rendered page or PDF indexing.
